label: MAN_HUMAN_2: Human as a quality is a Quality parameter
definition: Human as a quality is a Quality parameter; HumanFormAdmitted marks its inclusion in the range of Forms as an explicit optional open commitment. It asserts neither a human Form’s existence by itself nor that the Form is an ordinary human.
note: Semantic interface for the bounded issue #257 readings. Primary passages motivate this sense but do not define this modern relational encoding. A sourced replacement would need a passage fixing precisely these semantic boundaries.

formal_gap.meaning: Forms.HumanFormAdmitted s human says only that the quality human is admitted in the vocabulary s: s.Admitted human, the explicit optional open commitment to include human among the qualities whose Forms are in question. Its body applies the supplied predicate s.Admitted. Admission alone does not give a Form of human: a vocabulary can admit human while its FormOf relation is empty; existence of such a Form follows only with a further commitment such as OneOverMany.
formal_gap.examples_unavailable: Whether human is admitted is what Parmenides 130c leaves undecided; the commitment is recorded as optional and open, so no instance is asserted.
exclusions: The existence of a human Form by itself.
A human being: the Form, if admitted, is not an ordinary human (DISAMB-PLATONIC-HUMAN).
open_obligations: Not attributed to the young Socrates; a sourced replacement would need a passage fixing these boundaries.
No formalization candidate: admission is the supplied Admitted predicate.
